lines: Your eyes shatter, trembling wildly
They assign the underworld, truly beyond the beyond
Meeting sorrowful eyes is deliberate, exactly
Your ears break, trembling wildly
Everything collapses, witty and truly?
Tea? Whatever? Why?
Say it, what a terrible world
Carry the burden, enjoy the escape
Sound and letters diverge, politics
Now the sound that blasts inferiority
The higher we rise, the more the excitement cools, this heat, the attitude, bad for the ears
Only vague ones are shady
Love doesn't know, the higher we rise, higher still, a revolution?
That cannot be
